name: FactorsThruAlong.pullbackArrows
statement: C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (R : Presieve Y) [R.HasPullbacks f] : (Presieve.pullbackArrows f R).FactorsThruAlong R f

name: isSheafFor_of_factorsThru
statement: C} {S T : Presieve X} (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type*) (H : S.FactorsThru T) (hS : S.IsSheafFor P) (h : ∀ ⦃Y : C⦄ ⦃f : Y ⟶ X⦄, T f → ∃ (R : Presieve Y), R.IsSeparatedFor P ∧ R.FactorsThruAlong S f) : T.IsSheafFor P
